goal: On the Architecture board, incoming issues run in a live ticker over the diagram that can be minimised to a pill; picking an issue lights its card, keeps the side panel to a compact summary, and opens a large issue sheet (Overview, Stack, Card, Agent tabs) that folds into a bottom tab.
constraints: Follow the approved mockup B1: scratchpad issue-ux/site/mx/mx.js and mx.css, opt=b1.
The overlay (board.py overlay, polled every 5 s) is the only data path; heat.json gains a compact list of every open issue.
Clicking a card directly keeps today's full panel; only issue navigation uses the compact summary.
The ticker and sheet never pan or zoom the board; browser storage is wrapped in try/catch.
Reuse the existing Analyze and job flow for the Agent tab; no new job endpoints.

non_goals.description: No changes to the guard or its rules.
No new dashboard pages or menu entries; no changes to job runner behaviour.

acceptance.criterion: harness-signals tests pass, including the issue list in heat.json
Board DOM tests pass, including ticker, minimise, new-issue pill, compact summary and sheet tabs
Verified in Chrome on the running dashboard against real Nightwatch data
